library(fastglmm)
library(mvtnorm)
library(MASS)
library(glmmTMB)

Simulation for Gaussian regression 

sim_data <- function(n, beta, sigSq_g, rho, n_random, intercept, link, signal_frac = NULL, theta=NULL){

  # Create fixed covariates with given correlation rho
  Sigma <- matrix(c(1,rho,rho,1), 2)
  X <- scale(rmvnorm(n, c(0,0), Sigma))

  # random effecdt with n_random levels
  z <- factor(sample(seq(n_random), n, replace=TRUE))

  # Sparse design matrix for random effects
  df <- data.frame(X, z)
  Z <- sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + z, df)

  # Simulate random effect
  alpha <- rnorm(ncol(Z), 0, sd=sqrt(sigSq_g))

  # linear predictor based on interceptm, fixed & random effects
  eta <- intercept + as.matrix(X %*% beta + Z %*% alpha)

  # noise in Gaussian model
  sigSq_e <- (1-signal_frac)/signal_frac * var(eta)[1]

  # Simulate response
  df$y <- switch(link, 
    "gaussian" = eta + rnorm(n, 0, sd = sqrt(sigSq_e)),
    "poisson" = rpois(n, exp(eta)),
    "logistic" = rbinom(n, 1, prob=plogis(eta)),
    "nb" = rnegbin(n, exp(eta), theta = theta))

  # Unexplained variance for each model
  sigSq_noise <- switch(link, 
    "gaussian" = sigSq_e,
    "poisson" =  trigamma(exp(intercept)),
    "logistic" = pi^2 / 3,
    "nb" = trigamma(1/(1/exp(intercept) + 1/theta)))

  # variance components
  # varTotal = 
  # vc = c(beta^2, sigSq_g, sigSq_noise)

  signal_frac = var(eta)[1] / (var(eta)[1] + sigSq_noise)

  a = c(beta^2, sigSq_g)
  vc = c(signal_frac * a/sum(a), 1 - signal_frac)

  attr(df, "varFrac") = vc / sum(vc)
  df
}


df <- sim_data(n = 1e6, 
              beta = c(1,2), 
              sigSq_g = 2,
              rho = .7, 
              n_random = 1000,
              intercept = 3,
              "gaussian",
              signal_frac = .8)


fit <- fastlmm(y ~ X1 + X2 + (1|z), df)

varpart(fit)
##        X1        X2         z Residuals 
## 0.1159611 0.4638733 0.2202469 0.1999187
attr(df, "varFrac")
## [1] 0.1142857 0.4571429 0.2285714 0.2000000

Fixed intercept for Z, now fix

true variance fractions for non-normal 

df <- sim_data(n = 1e6, 
              beta = c(1,2), 
              sigSq_g = 1,
              rho = .7, 
              n_random = 500,
              intercept = -3,
              "poisson")

hist(df$y)

fit <- fastglmm(y ~ X1 + X2 + (1|z), df, family=poisson())

varpart(fit)
##        X1        X2         z Residuals 
## 0.1601416 0.6402481 0.1725216 0.0270887
attr(df, "varFrac")
## [1] 0.00357594 0.01430376 0.00357594 0.97854436
it = glmmTMB(y ~ X1 + X2 + (1|z), df, family=poisson())


# No variance component
df <- sim_data(n = 1e6, 
              beta = c(1,.2), 
              sigSq_g = 1e-5,
              rho = .7, 
              n_random = 500,
              intercept = 2,
              "poisson")

hist(df$y)

fit <- fastglmm(y ~ X1 + X2 + (1|z), df, family=poisson())

varpart(fit)
##           X1           X2            z    Residuals 
## 9.115835e-01 3.629820e-02 1.161418e-05 5.210670e-02
attr(df, "varFrac")
## [1] 8.664114e-01 3.465646e-02 8.664114e-06 9.892343e-02
median(df$y)
## [1] 7
fit1 = glm(y ~ X1 + X2, df, family=poisson())
varpart(fit1)
##         X1         X2  Residuals 
## 0.91159427 0.03629590 0.05210983
# HOW DOES RSQ COMPARE????
rsq::rsq(fit1, type="v")
## [1] 0.9748794
w = 1/(df$y + .1)
fit1 = lm(log(y + .1) ~ X1 + X2, df, weights=w / mean(w))
varpart(fit1)
##         X1         X2  Residuals 
## 0.51228583 0.01960208 0.46811210

Application to PsychAD dataset 

data(PsychAD)

form = PTPRG ~ Dx + Age + Sex + offset(log(libSize)) + (1|SubID)

fit <- fastglmm.nb(form, PsychAD)

varpart(fit)
##           Dx          Age          Sex        SubID    Residuals 
## 0.0133011913 0.0002195276 0.0001159415 0.0210472556 0.9653160840
